name: Holy Light

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

text: You raise your arms to the sky and pray fervently, surrounding yourself in a beacon of holy light. The beacon sheds bright light in a 30-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on you until the beginning of your next turn. Evil creatures in the area must succeed at a Will save save equal to your class DC or spell DC (whichever is higher) or become Dazzled for 1 round.
